rationale: Historical admission approved for research use. The 3939 prepared ALFRED Brent candidates have passed the established methodological and leakage-safety review. The two identified overlaps with existing Brent observations have matching values but different AvailableAt timestamps; existing admitted observations must be preserved and must not be overwritten or replaced. Admission authorization applies only to eligible non-overlapping historical research observations and does not authorize calibration, model validation, or modification of official HESI.
